name: OpenProject
description: Project management with work packages, Gantt charts, boards and time tracking

paths.name: Pgdata
paths.description: OpenProject's built-in PostgreSQL database with all your projects. Back it up.

paths.name: Assets
paths.description: Uploaded files and attachments, and this install's secret key and first admin password (.icestore-* files). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenProject web app and API, published on host as 6869

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: OPENPROJECT_HOST__NAME
variables.description: Required. The address you open OpenProject at, without http://: replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like 192.168.1.20:6869, or your domain. It must match what your browser shows.

variables.name: OPENPROJECT_HTTPS
variables.description: false lets you use OpenProject over plain http. Set to true when it is behind an https reverse proxy.

variables.name: OPENPROJECT_DEFAULT__LANGUAGE
variables.description: The language of the first data (types, statuses) and the default for new users, like en, de or fr.
